"''Business? Oh, well, there's not much business in Sorgan, so I can't say.|Din Djarin and Dara Vish, on Cara Dune|audio=BusinessInSorgan.flac|}} '''Dara Vish''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Bartender|proprietor]] [[Homeworld|hailing]] from the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]] who worked at the [[Sorgan Common House|Common House]] on the world. Around [[9 ABY]], she served [[grinjer]] [[bone broth]] and [[spotchka]] to the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] and his [[Youngling|young]] companion, [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], the former of whom bribed Vish so that she would speed up his order. Djarin also inquired Vish about a local named [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|Welcome, travelers. Can I interest you in anything?|Dara Vish, to Din Djarin|audio=WelcomeTravelers.flac|}} [[File:DaraVish.png|thumb|left|300px|Dara Vish accepted the Mandalorian's bribe.]] Dara Vish was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Homeworld|hailing]] from the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]]. On Sorgan, Vish owned and [[Bartender|bartended]] the [[Sorgan Common House|Common House]], working to create a welcoming establishment for her patrons. In [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|S1}} she had [[Death|taken down]] a creature known as a [[grinjer]], which provided for plenty of [[bone broth]] for the Common House. Shortly afterward, the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] and the [[Youngling|infant]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] visited the planet and then the house, where Vish welcomed them and took Djarin's order: [[bone]] [[Soup|broth]] for Grogu. She offered the Mandalorian broth as well, but he declined. He then took interest in the nearby human [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], inquiring about how long she had been there and what she was doing; Vish thought that she had seen Dune for around a [[Standard week|week]] and then chuckled, for there was not much business on Sorgan. Djarin then slipped her some [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], prompting Vish to assure the Mandalorian that his meal would come as soon as possible and that she would additionally serve him a flagon of [[spotchka]]. After noticing that Dune had left her seat, Djarin walked outside, tossing an additional [[Currency|coin]] to Vish in exchange for her watching Grogu for him. Later that [[Standard year|year]], Vish was present in the building when Dune fought a [[Unidentified Zabrak fighter|Zabrak fighter]], standing behind the bar and watching the tussle.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 7: The Reckoning}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I will get that broth to you as soon as possible, and I will throw in a flagon of spotchka just for good measure.|Dara Vish accepts the Mandalorian's bribe|audio=GoodMeasure.flac|}} Dara Vish was willing to accept bribes in exchange for better service, assuring Djarin that his [[Foodstuff|food]] would come as soon as possible after he gave [[Currency|credits]] to her and even adding free spotchka to the order. She considered all who visited her tavern a friend, with many of her regular customers happy to travel for her hospitality. Vish had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], light skin, and hazel-colored [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== While on Sorgan, Vish wore brown, lightly patterned [[clothing]]. ==Behind the scenes== Dara Vish first appeared in "[[Chapter 4: Sanctuary]]," the fourth episode of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season One|first season]]. The episode aired on [[November 29]], [[2019]].{{InsiderCite|201|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season One Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season One Companion}} In the episode, she was portrayed by [[Ida Darvish]] and was identified in the closing credits only as "Common House Proprietor." Her name of "Dara Vish," a [[tuckerization]] of Darvish's name, was given in the [[2021]] young readers reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Handbook]]'' by [[Matt Jones]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Dara Vish|imagecat=Images of Dara Vish}} *[[The Mandalorian Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian'' Junior Novel]] {{Ab|The Mandalorian Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *''[[The Mandalorian: Season 1: Volume 1]]'' *[[The Mandalorian – The Graphic Novel of Season 1|''The Mandalorian'' – The Graphic Novel of Season 1]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian 4|''The Mandalorian'' 4]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 7: The Reckoning}} ==Sources== *{{DisneyGallery|Process}} *{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-4-guide|text="Sanctuary" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Handbook]]'' {{1stID|Dara Vish}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Post-Galactic Civil War and the Mandalorian}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Dara Vish |fr=Dara Vish |ja=ダラ・ヴィッシュ |ka=დერა ვიში |nl=Dara Vish |pl=Dara Vish }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Vish, Dara}} [[Category:Bartenders]] [[Category:Business owners and executives]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
